why.en: With pointer acceleration on, the same hand movement moves the cursor a different distance depending on its speed, which makes aim inconsistent.
why.tr: İşaretçi ivmelenmesi açıkken aynı el hareketi, hızına göre imleci farklı mesafe taşır; bu da nişan almayı tutarsız yapar.

fixed.en: Mouse acceleration is now off, so the cursor follows the hand one to one.
fixed.tr: Fare ivmelenmesi artık kapalı, bu yüzden imleç ele birebir uyuyor.

apply: $v = ([string]$Target).Split(','); $k = 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse'; Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $k -Name MouseSpeed -Value $v[0] -Type String -ErrorAction Stop; Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $k -Name MouseThreshold1 -Value $v[1] -Type String -ErrorAction Stop; Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $k -Name MouseThreshold2 -Value $v[2] -Type String -ErrorAction Stop; rundll32.exe user32.dll,UpdatePerUserSystemParameters
revert: $k = 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse'; Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $k -Name MouseSpeed -Value '1' -Type String -ErrorAction Stop; Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $k -Name MouseThreshold1 -Value '6' -Type String -ErrorAction Stop; Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $k -Name MouseThreshold2 -Value '10' -Type String -ErrorAction Stop; rundll32.exe user32.dll,UpdatePerUserSystemParameters
